claims.claim: compute_autoais: sentence without citations: joint_entail = 0 (recall 0). Sentence with one citation: entail_prec += joint_entail (precision contribution = its recall). Precision denominator = total_citations, i.e. citations counted over in-range cited sentences, after at_most_citations truncation; per item precision = 0 if no valid citation. Sentences with 2+ citations get the irrelevance check.
claims.locator: eval.py lines 362-364 (no citations), 366-367 (out of range), 371 (total_citations += len(ref)), 386 (entail += joint_entail), 391-413 (precision branch, line 413 entail_prec += joint_entail), 416-417
claims.quote: ais_scores_prec.append(entail_prec / total_citations if total_citations > 0 else 0)
claims.verified_how: raw eval.py at commit 246c476 downloaded and read lines 301-440
claims.note: Refinement: 'all citations' excludes citations on sentences with a citation id out of range, and is capped by at_most_citations. A multi-citation sentence not entailed by the union adds 0 to entail_prec but its citations still enter the denominator. Recall is averaged per sentence, then per item.
